name: Sojat Pure Ultra-Fine Sifted Henna Powder
shortDescription: Pure natural, cloth-filtered Rajasthani Henna powder with high lawsone pigment content for rich dark stain.
fullDescription: Harvested directly from our family farms in Sojat, Rajasthan — renowned globally as the Henna City. Our henna leaves are dried naturally under solar shade, micro-milled and ultra-fine cloth-filtered to produce a silk-like powder that gives a deep rich mahogany burgundy stain.
ingredients: 100% Pure Natural Lawsonia Inermis (Henna) Leaf Powder
benefits: Deep, natural long-lasting dark stain
Acts as a natural hair conditioner and coolant
Zero synthetic chemicals, PPD, ammonia, or metallic salts
Cloth-sifted for clog-free Mehendi cone flow
usageInstructions: Mix powder with warm water and lemon juice/tea water into a smooth paste. Cover and soak for 6-8 hours for dye release. Apply to clean hair or skin. Leave for 2-3 hours before rinsing with plain water.

name: Natural Organic Indigo Powder for Dark Hair
shortDescription: Pure Indigofera Tinctoria leaf powder for natural black or rich brown shade when used with Henna.
fullDescription: Our Organic Indigo Powder is made exclusively from whole Indigofera Tinctoria leaves, solar-dried and micro-milled to create an ultra-fine, pure botanical hair dye. Used alone on light hair it produces a cool blue-green tint, but when applied after Henna (2-step method) or mixed with Henna, it yields rich chocolate-brown to jet-black tones with zero ammonia, PPD, or peroxide.
benefits: Natural black tint without peroxide or harsh dye chemicals
Coats and protects delicate hair shaft
Reduces premature greying and soothes scalp
usageInstructions: Mix with warm water and apply immediately on hair previously treated with Henna. Leave for 1-2 hours, then rinse with water. Avoid shampoo for 48 hours for full color oxidation.

name: Musky Dose Special Bridal Mehendi Cones (Pack of 12)
shortDescription: Freshly prepared 100% natural Mehendi cones infused with Eucalyptus & Nilgiri essential oil.
fullDescription: Ready-to-use smooth flowing bridal henna cones made with our fresh Sojat ultra-fine sifted henna paste, pure eucalyptus oil, clove oil, and cane sugar. Delivers intense dark stain within 24-48 hours.
benefits: Silky smooth extra fine tip flow
Dark dark brown to dark red stain
100% natural, chemical-free formulation
usageInstructions: Cut the tip desired thickness, apply intricate pattern on clean hands/feet. Allow to dry 2-4 hours. Scrape off paste (do not wash with water immediately). Apply mustard oil for maximum dark stain.

name: Herbal Amla Reetha Shikakai & Hibiscus Hair Pack
shortDescription: Traditional herbal hair-care blend for gentle cleansing, nourishing and conditioning.
fullDescription: A classic Indian ayurvedic formulation combining sun-dried natural Amla (Indian Gooseberry), Reetha (Soapnut), Shikakai, Hibiscus flower petals, and Bhringraj. Natural saponins cleanse hair without stripping natural scalp oils.
benefits: Natural soap-free herbal hair cleanser
Strengthens roots and reduces hair loss
Adds natural volume, luster, and bounce
usageInstructions: Soak 2-3 tablespoons in lukewarm water for 30 mins to form a gentle lathering paste. Apply onto scalp and lengths, massage gently, rinse off after 15-20 minutes.

name: Pure Sojat Damask Rose Water Spray
shortDescription: Steam-distilled pure natural Damask rose hydrosol toner & refreshing mist.
fullDescription: Directly steam distilled from handpicked morning rose blossoms. Hydrates skin, tightens pores, balances pH, and elevates skin glow with a delicate, captivating floral aroma.
ingredients: 100% Steam Distilled Rosa Damascena Flower Water
benefits: Instant cooling and pore tightening facial toner
Restores skin moisture barrier naturally
Ideal base for mixing henna and herbal face masks
usageInstructions: Mist directly onto cleansed face and neck mornings and evenings or whenever skin feels dry. Can also be mixed with herbal face powders.

name: Sojat Raw Whole Henna Leaves
shortDescription: Sun-dried premium green Lawsonia Inermis leaves directly from Sojat farms.
fullDescription: Whole unground henna leaves for wholesale buyers, DIY enthusiasts, and traditional remedies. Sourced directly from our farms during the peak September-October harvest season.
benefits: Pure, 100% natural whole henna harvest
Ideal for home grinding, hair oils, or botanical dye extracts
usageInstructions: Grind in a dry grinder or soak overnight in water or hair oil infusions.

name: Bridal Henna Oil
shortDescription: Pure botanical essential oil blend to intensify and deepen natural mehndi stains.
fullDescription: An artisan blend of high-terpene botanical essential oils specifically crafted to enhance the oxidation and stain depth of fresh Sojat Henna. Scented with pure Nilgiri eucalyptus, clove bud, and tea tree extracts.
benefits: Enhances deep rich dark henna stain
Aromatic natural botanical fragrance
Smooth application over dried mehndi motifs
usageInstructions: Dab gently over dried henna design using cotton pad or fingertips. Leave on overnight for maximum dye oxidation.

name: Pure Eucalyptus (Nilgiri) Essential Oil
shortDescription: Steam-distilled pure Nilgiri eucalyptus oil for mehndi mixing and invigorating aromatherapy.
fullDescription: 100% pure steam-distilled eucalyptus oil sourced from the Nilgiri hills. Rich in natural cineole terpenes, it is traditionally used as an essential ingredient in smooth Rajasthani henna paste formulations.
benefits: Traditional terping agent for dark mehndi stains
Refreshing, invigorating herbal aroma
Multipurpose botanical oil for aromatherapy and DIY blends
usageInstructions: Add a few drops to henna paste during preparation or use in aromatherapy diffusers.

name: Pure Tea Tree Essential Oil
shortDescription: 100% pure Australian tea tree essential oil for henna paste terping and purifying skincare.
fullDescription: Pure Melaleuca Alternifolia oil packed with natural terpinen-4-ol. Prized by henna artists for enhancing dye release and loved in skincare routines for its natural clarifying qualities.
ingredients: 100% Pure Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Essential Oil
benefits: High terpene density for henna dye release
Clarifying and purifying herbal properties
Ideal for skin toners, scalp packs, and henna paste
usageInstructions: Mix 1-2 drops with carrier oil for topical use or add to henna paste for dye enhancement.

name: Pure Clove Essential Oil
shortDescription: Distilled clove bud essential oil rich in eugenol for rich mehndi color and warm aroma.
fullDescription: Steam distilled from sun-cured clove buds. Contains high concentrations of eugenol, an aromatic botanical compound that creates pleasant warmth and supports henna pigment development.
ingredients: 100% Pure Syzygium Aromaticum (Clove) Bud Essential Oil
benefits: Warm eugenol-rich botanical oil
Traditional mehndi color booster
Soothing and aromatic herbal essence
usageInstructions: Add 2-3 drops to henna powder mixture or dilute with carrier oil for massage application.

name: Pure Organic Amla Powder
shortDescription: Micro-milled Indian Gooseberry (Amla) powder rich in Vitamin C for hair conditioning.
fullDescription: 100% natural, deseeded and shade-dried Indian Gooseberry fruit powder. A classic cornerstone of Ayurvedic hair care, Amla conditions strands, supports healthy scalp pH, and imparts natural shine.
benefits: Rich in natural Vitamin C and bioflavonoids
Strengthens hair roots and tones scalp
Adds natural volume and texture to hair strands
usageInstructions: Mix with water, rose water, or yogurt to form a smooth paste. Apply to scalp and hair for 30 minutes, then rinse.

name: Pure Natural Reetha (Soapnut) Powder
shortDescription: Natural plant saponin cleanser powder for chemical-free, gentle hair washing.
fullDescription: Crafted from pure deseeded Sapindus Mukorossi shells. Creates a mild, non-drying lather that removes excess oil and grime while keeping delicate scalp moisture balanced.
ingredients: 100% Pure Sapindus Mukorossi (Soapnut / Reetha) Shell Powder
benefits: Natural plant saponin cleanser
Gentle soap-free lather that purifies scalp
Maintains natural hair moisture and softness
usageInstructions: Mix with warm water to create a mild lathering herbal hair wash. Massage into scalp and rinse thoroughly.

name: Pure Ayurvedic Shikakai Powder
shortDescription: Traditional low-pH botanical conditioner powder for detangled, soft hair.
fullDescription: Finely ground from wild-harvested Acacia Concinna pods and bark. Naturally low in pH, Shikakai detangles hair without stripping natural protective oils, giving noticeable silkiness and bounce.
benefits: Traditional low-pH natural hair conditioner
Gently detangles and softens hair strands
Promotes silky smooth hair manageability
usageInstructions: Combine with water or herbal decoction into a paste. Apply from roots to tips, leave for 15 minutes, and rinse.

name: Pure Hibiscus Flower Petal Powder
shortDescription: Sun-dried red Hibiscus flower petal powder for deep conditioning and gloss.
fullDescription: 100% pure powder milled from shade-dried Hibiscus Rosa-Sinensis petals. Rich in natural botanical mucilage and alpha-hydroxy acids that condition dull hair and hydrate dry scalp.
ingredients: 100% Pure Hibiscus Rosa-Sinensis Flower Petal Powder
benefits: Natural botanical conditioning and shine enhancer
Nourishes scalp and supports lustrous hair
Imparts subtle reddish tint when combined with henna
usageInstructions: Blend with henna or hair oil masks. Apply evenly and rinse with lukewarm water after 30-45 minutes.

name: Pure Bhringraj (Eclipta Alba) Powder
shortDescription: Authentic Keshraj herb powder for revitalizing scalp nourishment and hair strength.
fullDescription: Known in Ayurveda as the "King of Herbs for Hair", pure whole-plant Eclipta Alba powder provides cooling relief to heated scalps, revitalizes follicles, and improves overall hair density.
ingredients: 100% Pure Eclipta Alba / Prostrata (Bhringraj) Whole Herb Powder
benefits: Revered ayurvedic Keshraj herb for hair vitality
Soothes and cools the scalp
Improves overall hair volume and thickness
usageInstructions: Mix with coconut oil, sesame oil, or water. Massage onto scalp and leave for 30 minutes before washing.

name: Pure Natural Neem Leaf Powder
shortDescription: Pure Azadirachta Indica leaf powder for scalp purification and clarifying face masks.
fullDescription: Carefully harvested and solar-dried whole Neem leaves ground into a micro-fine powder. Revered for centuries in traditional Indian wellness for its clarifying, cooling, and skin-cleansing benefits.
benefits: Clarifying botanical with purifying properties
Soothes itchy scalp and skin irritations
Ideal for dual-use hair and facial masks
usageInstructions: Mix with rose water or plain water to make a face or scalp mask. Apply for 15-20 minutes, then rinse.

name: Pure Organic Moringa Leaf Powder
shortDescription: Nutrient-rich Moringa Oleifera green leaf powder for enriching hair and scalp masks.
fullDescription: Pure organic Moringa Oleifera leaves milled into a fine vibrant green powder. Packed with natural plant proteins, vitamins, and minerals that replenish dry scalp and nourish brittle hair.
benefits: Rich in amino acids, minerals, and phytonutrients
Nourishes dry scalp and brittle hair strands
Adds strength and vitality to herbal hair packs
usageInstructions: Add 1-2 tablespoons to hair packs, henna blends, or herbal rinses.

name: Pure Fenugreek (Methi) Seed Powder
shortDescription: High-mucilage Methi seed powder for deep moisture, conditioning, and softness.
fullDescription: Finely ground Trigonella Foenum-Graecum seeds. Natural plant mucilage creates a rich conditioning gel upon soaking, providing remarkable slip, detangling, and moisture retention.
benefits: High mucilage content for intense slip and conditioning
Moisturizes dry scalp and softens rough hair
Improves combability and reduces tangles
usageInstructions: Soak with warm water for 15 minutes to allow natural mucilage to expand into a gel-like mask. Apply to hair and rinse.

name: Pure Brahmi (Bacopa Monnieri) Powder
shortDescription: Traditional Bacopa Monnieri herb powder for scalp cooling and root vitality.
fullDescription: Pure Bacopa Monnieri leaves harvested and milled with care. Renowned in Ayurvedic hair therapy for soothing the mind, cooling the scalp, and fortifying hair strands from the root.
benefits: Traditional revitalizing herb for scalp cooling
Nourishes hair follicles and strengthens strands
Enhances shine and natural softness
usageInstructions: Mix with amla and bhringraj powders with warm water. Apply to scalp for 25-30 minutes and rinse.

name: Pure Natural Curry Leaf Powder
shortDescription: Shade-dried Murraya Koenigii leaf powder rich in beta-carotene for hair nourishment.
fullDescription: Made from whole fresh green curry leaves, shade-dried to lock in essential phytonutrients. Traditional home remedy to support natural hair color depth, scalp vitality, and gloss.
benefits: Rich in beta-carotene and essential amino acids
Maintains natural hair pigmentation and shine
Nourishes roots and supports healthy scalp balance
usageInstructions: Infuse into warm coconut oil or mix with yogurt as a revitalizing scalp mask.

name: Pure Jatamansi (Spikenard) Root Powder
shortDescription: Aromatic Spikenard rhizome powder for soothing scalp masks and traditional hair care.
fullDescription: Finely milled from wild-collected Nardostachys Jatamansi roots. Known for its earthy, woody fragrance and natural conditioning qualities that leave hair smooth, soft, and lightly aromatic.
benefits: Calming and soothing herbal botanical for scalp care
Imparts natural conditioning and gloss
Traditional aromatic herb used in royal hair formulations
usageInstructions: Blend with hair oils or herbal paste, apply gently to scalp, and rinse after 20 minutes.

name: Pure Natural Beetroot Powder
shortDescription: Vibrant natural red beetroot powder for rich burgundy dye highlights and face masks.
fullDescription: Dehydrated and finely ground Beta Vulgaris roots. A favorite botanical color additive among henna enthusiasts for achieving rich ruby tones without artificial dyes or chemicals.
benefits: Natural botanical pigment for reddish-burgundy tints
Enriches henna mixes with deep ruby tones
Gentle on skin and hair with zero synthetic dyes
usageInstructions: Add 2-3 tablespoons to henna powder paste for ruby highlights or mix with rose water as a facial mask.

name: Pure Rajasthani Multani Mitti (Fuller's Earth)
shortDescription: Natural mineral clay from Rajasthan for oil-balancing, deep-pore facial cleansing.
fullDescription: Sourced from mineral-rich clay beds in Rajasthan. Multani Mitti acts as a gentle vacuum for skin impurities, drawing out excess sebum, unclogging pores, and leaving skin refreshed and toned.
ingredients: 100% Pure Solum Fullonum (Fuller's Earth / Multani Mitti)
benefits: Absorbs excess facial oils and deep cleanses pores
Natural cooling and skin refreshing clay mask
Leaves skin soft, smooth, and revitalized
usageInstructions: Mix 1-2 spoons with Musky Dose Rose Water or milk. Apply evenly on face, let dry for 10-15 minutes, and rinse with cold water.

name: Pure Natural Sandalwood (Chandan) Powder
shortDescription: Classic aromatic Chandan powder for skin cooling, toning, and radiant complexion.
fullDescription: Micro-fine powder ground from authentic sandalwood. Celebrated for its calming aroma and time-honored skincare benefits, it soothes sun-exposed skin and imparts a natural, healthy radiance.
benefits: Classic Indian aromatic skincare powder
Soothes sun-exposed skin and refines complexion
Delicate, lingering woody aroma
usageInstructions: Mix with pure rose water or Multani Mitti into a fine paste. Apply on face and neck, relax for 15 minutes, then rinse.

name: Pure Lavender Essential Oil
shortDescription: Steam-distilled French lavender essential oil for calming aromatherapy and skin soothing.
fullDescription: 100% pure Lavandula Angustifolia essential oil. Known for its relaxing floral aroma, it is widely used in bedtime diffusers, restorative bath soaks, and soothing skincare formulations.
benefits: Calming, floral aromatic botanical essence
Soothing companion for skincare and scalp oils
Versatile for aromatherapy diffusers and DIY beauty
usageInstructions: Dilute 2-3 drops in carrier oil for skin application or add to aromatherapy diffuser.

name: Pure Rosemary Essential Oil
shortDescription: Concentrated Rosemary leaf essential oil for scalp stimulation and hair vitality.
fullDescription: Steam distilled from fresh Rosmarinus Officinalis leaves. High in 1,8-cineole and camphor, Rosemary oil is the gold standard herbal essential oil for invigorating the scalp and hair care routines.
benefits: Popular aromatic herb for hair and scalp wellness
Invigorating herbal scent that refreshes the senses
Pairs exceptionally well with coconut, castor, and amla hair oils
usageInstructions: Dilute 3-5 drops in a tablespoon of carrier oil. Massage gently into scalp or add to hair rinse water.

name: Pure Peppermint Essential Oil
shortDescription: Refreshing Mentha Piperita essential oil for cooling scalp care and uplifting aroma.
fullDescription: Steam distilled from fresh peppermint leaves, delivering a potent natural menthol concentration. Creates an instant cooling sensation on tired skin and refreshes the mind with a crisp herbal fragrance.
benefits: Cooling menthol sensation for scalp and skin
Crisp, energizing herbal aroma
Refreshing addition to foot soaks, scalp rinses, and diffusers
usageInstructions: Dilute 1-2 drops with carrier oil before applying to skin or scalp. Do not use undiluted.

name: Pure Lemongrass Essential Oil
shortDescription: Crisp citrus-herbal lemongrass essential oil for skin toning and natural room freshening.
fullDescription: Steam distilled from fresh Cymbopogon leaves. Known for its uplifting, sweet-citrus fragrance and natural astringent properties that cleanse and revitalize the skin.
benefits: Bright, citrusy herbal aroma that revitalizes spaces
Natural toning properties for oily skin types
Excellent for aromatic steam, diffusers, and body oils
usageInstructions: Add 2-3 drops to water diffuser or dilute in massage oil for a revitalizing herbal experience.
